title: Chapter 613 - 613 Alive; How Dare?!
content:
Chapter 613 - 613 Alive; How Dare?!

Chapter 613 - 613 Alive; How Dare?!

613 Alive; How Dare?!

Abraham noticed the change in Lin Fan’s expression and asked, “You… Do you recognize the words on it?”

“Little Thunderclap Monastery,” Lin Fan said.

Ji Erku’s eyes lit up when he heard that.

“Monastery? A monastery? The martial arts of the world came from a monastery! Master, are there many powerful martial arts manuals in here?” Sam shouted excitedly.

Lin Fan’s lips twitched.

Did Sam use to watch martial arts dramas every day?

Lin Fan shook his head and walked forward.

He was also filled with curiosity toward this Little Thunderclap Monastery.

Generally speaking, a monastery was a place to worship Buddha. It should be majestic and grand.

However, the moment everyone entered the Little Thunderclap Monastery, they felt a gust of cold wind assaulting them, causing them to involuntarily shiver.

The light inside was extremely dim, and if the few of them were far away, they would not even be able to see each other’s figures clearly.

The few of them kept moving forward…

Abraham frowned. “There seems to be something ahead.”

Everyone continued to walk forward with doubts.

In the next moment, a ten-meter-tall, malevolent-looking statue with ten snake tails appeared in front of them.

There was no Buddha statue in the temple, but there was a statue of a monster. How strange was that?

When he saw the statue, Abraham’s heart trembled inexplicably. His hair stood on end.

“I don’t know what’s going on, but my heart is suddenly palpitating,” he said in a low voice.

“I…” Sam said in a trembling voice. “Me too.”

At this moment, a dull voice suddenly sounded in the darkness.

Sam said in fear, “What… What’s that sound?”

The Heavenly Hound barked into the darkness.

However, Lin Fan’s expression remained calm.

Others could not see the situation in the darkness, but he could.

This was because he possessed Night Vision.

In the next moment, a skinny man slowly appeared in front of everyone.

He was a fair-skinned person. In this dark space, he looked extremely awe-inspiring and strange.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

123 Wooden Man: [Isn’t this the hero of Franks Nation, Anthony Lawson? He died not long ago!]

Flying Kite in the Sky: [That’s right! It’s Anthony Lawson! He’s a painter, and I’ve seen his interviews before.]

Heart: [Wasn’t he eaten by a snake? Why is he here again?]

Forced by Life: [Could the snake have just swallowed him but didn’t digest him?]

Great Great Great: [How is that possible? I saw him get his head bitten by a snake! His limbs were all bitten off! It was very bloody!]

Clear Sky: [This… Could it be a ghost?]

As soon as that person commented that, the comments in the live broadcast room suddenly stopped.

…

When Sam saw that it was a man, he could not help but heave a sigh of relief and said in English, “Hello, I’m Sam from Bai Country. Who are you?”

The man grinned, revealing a set of thick teeth.

The next moment, his mouth opened wide…

His entire mouth actually became several meters in size, and behind it, a snake body that was several meters thick stretched out!

It was actually a giant python!

The python rushed toward Sam, Lin Fan, Abraham, and the Heavenly Hound.

That appearance…

It was as if it wanted to swallow them all in one gulp.

It was ferocious and terrifying!

Sam, Abraham, and the others all turned pale.

Lin Fan pulled out his sword calmly.

A sword light flashed.

The thick silver snake body was split into two from the middle.

Lin Fan slashed it with his sword!

Fresh blood flowed freely.

An emotionless voice rang out at the scene.

[The first to kill a level-seven Silver Python. You’ve obtained a level-seven treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Silver Python. The number of endangered animals in Hua Nation has increased by 50%.]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing patted her chest lightly and said, “That scared me to death.”

Above the Mountains: [F*ck! That person is actually Silver Python!]

Wind: [No wonder. I said before that the guy looked like the hero of Franks Nation. So it turns out this is the case.]

Life Essence: [Fortunately, God Lin’s reaction was fast enough.]

Sky Lifting Pillar: [God Lin is invincible!]

Swaying Trees: [Hehe, the number of endangered animals has increased by 50% again! Does that mean that I might be able to raise pandas soon? God Lin, keep it up!]

…

Lin Fan opened the treasure chest in front of him.

[You’ve obtained 500 points of spiritual energy. Do you want to use them?]

At the same time, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—5,000 points of spiritual energy.]

Lin Fan turned around and said, “Heavenly Hound, use these 500 points of spiritual energy.”

The Heavenly Hound wagged its tail and went forward to touch the ball of light with its paw.

When Lin Fan opened the treasure chest and the Heavenly Hound accepted the 500 points of spiritual energy, no one noticed that the stone floor was like a sponge that quickly sucked in the python’s blood.

Soon, there was nothing left.

On the other hand, the black eyes of the huge statue not far away shook slightly. It was very strange.

Then, cracks appeared on the surface of the statue, and dust fell on Sam’s head.

He rubbed his head and muttered, “There’s so much dust.”

The Heavenly Hound, which had just used its spiritual power, suddenly opened its mouth and let out a loud cry.

At the same time, all the fur on its body stood up.

It was ready to fight at any time!

“What’s wrong, Heavenly Hound?” Sam asked.

At this moment, the cracking sound became louder and louder.

The stones on the surface of the statue fell down one after another, smashing into the ground with a loud sound.

“Master, this place seems to be collapsing!” Sam cried out in fear.

However, Lin Fan did not seem to hear him at all. He just raised his head and looked ahead.

Sam could not help but raise his head.

In the next moment, Sam’s eyes and mouth opened wide. He was completely stunned.

That was because he saw that the giant monster statue in front of them had actually come alive.

After the rocks fell off the surface, the monster revealed its golden skin.

Ten thick snake tails were twisting and turning. On its ferocious head, its sharp eyes were filled with a scarlet light.

Its awe-inspiring and extremely terrifying aura made the air turn cold.

At this moment…

Even the entire space seemed to have been frozen by this terrifying aura. Nothing was able to move at all.

At this moment, the giant monster let out a loud voice.

“How dare you?!”

Its voice was like thunder, exploding everyone’s ears.

The entire Small Thunderclap Monastery started shaking.

The monster was actually speaking human language!

Moreover, it was speaking Hua language!
